title: Anomaly Detection and Automatic Labeling for Solar Cell Quality Inspection Based on Generative Adversarial Network
mechanism: GAN anomaly detection trained on normal mono EL cells; anomaly maps used as automatic labels for a supervised FCN.
adaptation: Historical EL AD-to-label baseline for the benchmark only.
evidence: R: 1,873 mono EL cells; models trained on automatic labels reported comparable to manual labels (no numbers in abstract).
